## Type

- [ ] `feat` - New feature
- [ ] `fix` - Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` - Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `docs` - Documentation only
- [ ] `test` - Adding or updating tests
- [ ] `ci` - CI/CD changes
- [ ] `chore` - Maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and each one fails when the guard it covers is removed
- [ ] The gates of `.github/workflows/ci.yml` pass locally (`cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -D warnings`, `cargo test`, the `ci/` checks)
- [ ] No new dependency, or one agreed in an issue
- [ ] Doc comments on new public items
- [ ] Design documents updated if a decision, an identifier or a glossary term changed (`doc/decisions.md` in the same commit)
